messages:
vivian: quick sync request 11 we need a tight mapping from Datadog monitors -> Redwood runbooks for marketplace GPU customers. objective: alert payload should include a runbook link and severity so SOC can respond automatically. can we lock this before next Tue push? :eyes:

sam: i can take runbooks. can someone post the canonical monitor list/tags?

leo: ping @datadog-pm. also decision: do we ship monitor templates in the marketplace bundle or just dashboards + IaC examples? leaning templates + policy as code.

mia: for runbooks include: severity (P1/P2), SLA tier (hosted/dedicated/private), quick triage steps, rollback/fallback model variant. keep it terse.

jordan: automation needs the alert JSON fields we plan to rely on: `monitor`, `value`, `tags`, `dashboard_url`, `triggered_at`.

vivian: @datadog-pm can you share starter monitor names + recommended tags so sam can map runbooks to tags like `redwood:gpu` and `marketplace:public`?

datadog-pm: starter list below (we'll expand in partner repo):
- llm_gpu_high_memory (tags: redwood:gpu, severity:critical)
- llm_inference_latency_p90 (tags: redwood:latency, severity:warning)
- kv_cache_miss_rate (tags: redwood:cache, severity:warning)
- model_load_failures (tags: redwood:model, severity:critical)

we'll add monitors-as-code snippets (datadog terraform).

sam: thanks. sample runbook i'm planning:
```
id: llm_gpu_high_memory
severity: P1
condition: GPU memory > 95% for 3m
actions:
 - check nvidia-smi for processes
 - recommended: scale out dedicated pool or route to lower mem quantized variant
 - contact: infra-oncall
runbook_url: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/llm_gpu_high_memory
datadog_monitor_id: dd-12345
```

leo: include `datadog_monitor_id` to make alert <> runbook correlation deterministic. also let's publish a terraform example that creates monitors with the `redwood:*` tags.

mia: i'll draft recommended dashboard widgets: heatmap GPUs by mem usage, top 10 processes table, recent model versions. will share widget JSON.

jordan: sample alert payload we expect from Datadog webhook:
```
{
 "monitor": "llm_gpu_high_memory",
 "value": 98.3,
 "timestamp": 1736505000,
 "tags": ["redwood:gpu","marketplace:public"],
 "dashboard_url": "https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/abc123"
}
```
when our webhook ingests this, it should create an incident and attach `runbook_url` + `severity` automatically.

vivian: next steps:
- @datadog-pm: push monitor templates + tags to partner repo by Thu EOD
- @sam: draft runbooks for first 3 monitors by Fri noon
- @mia: widget JSON + example dashboard by Fri
- @leo: propose IaC approach (tf provider vs dd-terraform) and example by Fri

ops-bot: sam created runbook `llm_gpu_high_memory` (PR #421). monitor templates CI scheduled 2024-11-10T06:00Z. :robot_face:

datadog-pm: will add README with tag conventions and recommended thresholds. also we'll include minimal terraform to create monitors and webhooks.

sam: opening PR now, tagging infra-oncall and docs for review.

vivian: great work. we'll demo alert->runbook flow in the marketplace dry-run next week. if blockers surface ping me. :rocket:
